description: This Python source file defines a client class 'GeminiFileAPI' for interacting with Google's Gemini File API, enabling file uploads, retrieval, listing, and deletion. It includes methods for uploading files via resumable protocol, fetching file metadata, listing uploaded files, and deleting files. The class manages API keys, URLs, and handles asynchronous HTTP requests with aiohttp.
